description: Cartografia de Riscos Naturais - Suscetibilidade à ocorrência de Movimentos de Vertente - Região Autónoma dos Açores (RAA) is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Secretaria Regional do Ambiente e Ação Climática / Governo dos Açores . The Mapping of Susceptibility to the occurrence of Strand Movements was drawn up for the Regional Directorate for the Environment (X Regional Government of the Azores) by the Azores Seismic Monitoring and Information Centre as part of the study ‘Assessment of geological hazards and delimitation of vulnerable areas to be considered in terms of risks ... Coverage: Secretaria Regional do Ambiente e Ação Climática / Governo dos Açores . The portal shows the English title as "Cartography of Natural Hazards - Susceptibility to the occurrence of Strand Movements - Autonomous Region of the Azores " (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Secretaria Regional do Ambiente e Ação Climática / Governo dos Açores . Its keywords include hvd, raa, observacao-da-terra-e-do-ambiente, sao-miguel, terceira, sraac-gra. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
